name: kay
description: Language support for .kay components: diagnostics, hover, completion and go-to-definition through the kay language server

kay.bun.path.description: The Bun executable that runs the language server.

kay.server.path.description: Path to the kay CLI, absolute or relative to the workspace. Empty uses the workspace's node_modules/kay, or src/cli.ts inside the kay repository itself.

kay.routes.description: Directory of the pages, relative to the workspace, so route params and links are typed.
